summary: Frontend cockpit verified end-to-end. Demo login succeeds and lands on Dashboard which renders ONLY the Auto-Trader cockpit (Header + AutoTrader). All required data-testid selectors present: autobot-cockpit, autobot-state, autobot-connection (Connesso), autobot-equity (€9,996.70), autobot-open-pnl (+€0.00), autobot-open-count (0/10), autobot-last-run (23/09, 07:01), autobot-next-run, autobot-open-section/table/empty, autobot-closed-section/table (shows 1 EUR/USD BUY closed trade with -€0.17 P&L). START flow: clicking autobot-start-button triggered a window.confirm which was accepted; state badge flipped FERMO → ATTIVO; autobot-stop-button and autobot-runnow-button appeared; autobot-log-toggle expanded showing 'Bot AVVIATO — valutazione segnali in corso' log entry. STOP flow: autobot-stop-button clicked; final screenshots confirm state returned to FERMO with 'Avvia bot' button visible — bot left in STOPPED state as required. Mobile viewport (390x844): no horizontal overflow (scrollWidth == clientWidth == 390). Old research panels (Confronta pesi, walk-forward, Discovery, Watchlist, AI, candle chart) are all absent. The word 'backtest' appears only in the footer disclaimer (informational), not as a panel.
